description: Live verified index of AI and cloud startup credit programs. Accepts optional stack, stage, and minimum value filters. Returns count, updated_at, opportunities, and api.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

min_value.description: Minimum credit value in USD to filter by (optional). Example: 5000

stack.description: Optional stack filter. Example: ["openai","vercel","aws"]. Leave empty to include all programs.

stage.description: Your stage: solo (1 person), early (2 to 10), growth (10+). Default: solo.
